summary: Gone lookout site in Lucas County, Ohio, known only from Forest Fire Lookout Association registry listings; no build, staffing or site details found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what remains.

events.note: Entered in the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 3, 2014 as US 1561, OH 7

evidence.supports: Site is in Lucas County, Ohio
Register added the site on September 3, 2014
Association list marks the tower as gone and gives its position
evidence.quote: Irwin Lucas 41.62872 -83.78277 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1561, OH 7

evidence.supports: Register is sponsored by the Forest Fire Lookout Association
evidence.quote: The National Register of Former Lookout Sites is sponsored by the Forest Fire Lookout Association with support from the American Resources Group

evidence.supports: Over 8,000 fire lookouts at one time in 49 states

notes_for_editor: Registry-only story. Both listings give US 1561, OH 7 and nearly the same coordinates (association 41.62872, -83.78277; register 41.628889, -83.782778). No agency, build date, staffing or site description was found, so the agency field stays blank. Lucas County archive and Toledo library search results were search hits only and were not opened. A Maumee State Forest search hit was not verified and no source ties it to Irwin, so it is not mentioned.
